Class ElementClassifier

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.gui.element.internal.interaction.ElementClassifier
public final class ElementClassifier extends Object
Cheap classifier: tagName, type, role/ARIA, contenteditable, disabled flags, Appium mobile class names, and Windows/UIA ControlType tokens. Conservative by design — ambiguous custom widgets return ElementKind.UNKNOWN. Shared by Selenium Wave B, Playwright Wave C, mobile Wave D, and desktop Wave E (#5732).
